text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was during a training session to strengthen her legs on Chairwoman Akikawa's private beach, which also doubled as an extracurricular activity—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah...
Kh, what a fast fish...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp*... It got away~.
It would've been so delicious in a seafood hot pot, too...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Running through water is even harder than dirt...
Can't be helped, I'll have to make do with what we have—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nothing is impossible for the Class Rep!
Through fire or water!
There is only Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-senpai chased after the fish
with insane speed...
and cornered it against the rocks?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Now's our chance... Biko-chan! The second I lift this rock, grab it~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Let's coordinate together! Special Move! Triangle Caaatch!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Buooono☆
Nice catch on the fish, Biko-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thank you too, Bakushin O-san~!
Would you like to share some hot pot with us if you want?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
While I appreciate the offer,
I still have duties to fulfill as an exemplary class representative... so excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Towards a 3,600m Bakushin!
Blaze fiercely, my legsss and hipsss!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Taking on one challenge after another...
That was so wonderfully buono! I've gotta do my best tooâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono seemed deeply inspired.
From that day on, her running gained even more power and intensity...!
